media.app.title: Media Library
media.theme.title: Theme: {mode}
media.upload.title: Pick images, GIFs or videos to add to this collection
media.rail.title: Collections
media.rail.empty_warn_one: 1 empty collection — anything pointing at it renders a blank layer
media.rail.empty_warn_many: {n} empty collections — anything pointing at them renders a blank layer
media.list.title: Collection library
media.list.sub: {base} — click a collection to open it
media.list.no_match: No collection has “{q}” in its name or description.
media.empty.title: No collections yet
media.empty.body: A collection is a named bag of raw material: images, GIFs and videos kept in one place. Other extensions just point at the collection id and let the machine pick — at random, in cycle, or named by AI — so the same picture never has to be uploaded five times.
media.collection.no_desc_edit: No description — click to write one
media.hint.random: Random: every call takes any one file, and may repeat the one before it.
media.hint.cycle: Cycle: walks the grid in order so the same file is not taken twice in a row — the dashed tile is the one coming next.
media.hint.ai: AI picks: click a tile to name the exact file, then press “Try a pick”.
media.pick.try_title: Try one pick — preview only, the cycle cursor stays where it is
media.pick.empty: Empty collection — nothing to pick yet.
media.pick.cycle_this_next: The next call takes exactly this file.
media.pick.cycle_position: Position {pos} of {total} in the cycle. Whatever the cycle reaches is what gets taken.
media.pick.random_odds: On every call this file has a 1 in {n} chance of being taken.
media.pick.ai_this: “Try a pick” will take the file you selected.
media.pick.ai_hint: Click a tile in the grid to name the exact file.
media.next.empty: Empty collection — anything pointing here renders a blank layer.
media.next.random: Every call takes any one of {n} files.
media.next.ai_none: AI picks: click a tile in the grid to name the exact file.
media.files.no_match: No file in this collection has “{q}” in its name.
media.empty_col.title: “{name}” has no files yet
media.empty_col.body: Drag images, GIFs or videos and drop them anywhere on this page. File names are kept as they are — meaningful names help “AI picks” choose better.
media.empty_col.foot_before: Extensions can point at this collection with the id
media.empty_col.foot_after: right now — files may arrive later, the machine will pick once they do.
media.drop.title_generic: Drop to add to this collection
media.drop.title: Drop to add to “{name}”
media.drop.hint: Images, GIFs or videos · file names are kept as they are
media.delete.collection_with_files: Delete “{name}” and the {n} files inside it? This cannot be undone.
media.delete.keep_files: Keep the files on disk, only drop the collection from the list
media.insp.all_have_files: Every collection has files to pick from.
media.insp.empty_row: {name} — anything pointing here renders a blank layer
media.insp.how_body: Each collection is a named bag of raw material. An extension points at the collection id and lets the machine pick — the same picture is used again and again, only the words on the thumbnail change.
media.insp.cover_video_only: All video — no image yet to use as a cover
media.insp.cover_none: No cover yet — the first file becomes the cover
media.usage.title: Used by
media.usage.body_before: No usage data. This page cannot tell which templates call this collection — to point at it, use the id
media.usage.body_after: in Thumbnail Studio or Content Studio.
media.create.title: New collection
media.create.name_ph: e.g. Red backgrounds, Male avatars, Pre-cut clips
media.create.desc_ph: What it holds and what it is for — so it still makes sense next month
media.create.note: A collection has exactly ONE level: a name, with files inside. There are no subfolders — if you need to split it up, make another collection.
media.create.need_name: The collection needs a name — the name is what other extensions look at to choose it.
media.msg.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard: {err}
media.msg.copy_manual: The browser will not copy automatically — select it by hand: {text}
media.msg.list_failed: Could not load the collection list: {err}
media.msg.collection_deleted_kept: Deleted “{name}” — the files are still on disk.
media.msg.collection_empty_hint: This collection is empty — drag files and drop them anywhere on the page, or press “Upload”.
media.msg.reload_failed: Could not reload the collection: {err} — press “← Collections” and open it again.
media.msg.ai_selected: Press “Try a pick” to have the server take exactly “{name}”.
media.msg.ai_none: No file selected — “AI picks” needs a file name.
media.msg.no_collection_upload: No collection is open to upload into.
media.msg.upload_busy: Another upload is already running — let it finish first.
media.msg.drop_no_collection: No collection is open — open one and drop again, the files will land in it.
media.msg.drop_nothing: There was no file in what you dropped.
media.msg.canvas_no_path: The canvas passed over a file with no path.
media.msg.canvas_pending: Got “{path}” from the canvas — open the collection you want it in and it will be copied there.
media.msg.pick_empty: This collection is empty — nothing to pick.
media.msg.pick_ai_need: “AI picks” needs a file name — click a tile in the grid, then pick again.
media.msg.picked: Picked “{name}”. Preview only, the cycle keeps its place.
media.msg.picked_why: Picked “{name}” — {why}. Preview only, the cycle keeps its place.
